bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
for unit in gace-public-video-all-joined-retry-20261114.service gace-public-video-all-joined-20261114.service;do
 state="$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null || echo not_loaded)"
 echo "UNREQUESTED_UNIT_$unit=$state"
 test "$state" != active
 test "$state" != activating
done
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test -d /mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos
test -f scripts/userbot_public_video_archive.py
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health
state="$(systemctl --user show gace-public-video-only-nippon-20261114.service -p ActiveState --value 2>/dev/null || echo not_loaded)"
echo "SINGLE_CHANNEL_UNIT_BEFORE=$state"
if test "$state" != active && test "$state" != activating;then
  systemd-run --user --collect --unit=gace-public-video-only-nippon-20261114 --working-directory="$PWD" /usr/bin/python3 -u scripts/userbot_public_video_archive.py --channel-username theGreatOldDaysofNipponGV --all
  echo ONLY_REQUESTED_CHANNEL_JOB=LAUNCHED
else echo ONLY_REQUESTED_CHANNEL_JOB=ALREADY_ACTIVE;fi
systemctl --user show gace-public-video-only-nippon-20261114.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result --no-pager
echo ALL_OTHER_CHANNEL_UNITS=INACTIVE
echo USERBOT_SESSION=UNCHANGED
